messages:
carmen_cs: Heads-up — Nimbus Health onboarding hit some SLO noise last week. Two tiny downtime windows (~5m each) plus a ~1h p95 latency spike during their bulk import. Need to align on whether credits apply and what to tell them before Friday renewal review. @liam_eng @andre_sales
liam_eng: Can you paste the exact windows and region? I want to grep logs and check autoscaler events. @mira_support any incident ticket yet?
opsbot: Incident INC-2026 created for Nimbus Health — tags: onboarding, uptime, latency. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026
carmen_cs: Windows: 2026-03-12 02:18-02:23 UTC (eu-west-1), 2026-03-15 11:05-11:10 UTC (eu-west-1). Latency spike approx 2026-03-14 03:00-04:00 UTC during their full-file import. Shared raw export to @liam_eng via DM.
liam_eng: Quick triage: the two short outages look like autoscaler flapping + a worker OOM in eu-west-1. Latency spike lines up with the import hitting the non-streaming code path (large batch). I'll open a config PR to limit burst and enable streaming ingestion for large uploads.
andre_sales: Customer is worried about invoice credits and how this affects renewal dialog. CS should have a clear credit calc + a conciliatory offer ready. Finance needs the expected dollar impact.
mira_support: Can someone confirm the exact SLA trigger for latency credits? Is it p95 > 1s AND affected request pct threshold? I don't recall the exact table.
carmen_cs: Our SLA doc: uptime SLA 99.9% monthly; latency SLO p95 < 1s. Credit rules are tiered — example: p95 >1.1s AND affected >0.5% => 5% credit. I'll compute exact numbers but rough math: March (31d) = 44640 minutes. Observed downtime 10m => uptime ~= 99.977% (no uptime credit). Latency degraded window ~60m but need impacted request % to decide.
liam_eng: Running these queries now. First pull total requests during spike, then baseline:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM requests
WHERE account = 'nimbus-health'
AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-14T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-14T04:00:00Z';
```
I'll also grep autoscaler logs for the two outage windows and attach root-cause notes.
mira_support: Reminder from finance/legal: if a credit applies, handle as an invoice adjustment (no contract amendments). Sales needs estimate before the renewal meeting.
andre_sales: If credit applies, propose: 5% March invoice credit + one complimentary 90-minute enablement session (runbook + live walkthrough) + 2-week priority bug-fix queue for onboarding issues. That usually helps surface trust for renewal.
liam_eng: I'll share counts and a short RCA by EOD. Also opened PR to change autoscaler cooldown + streaming flag. Canary deploy scheduled for tomorrow morning.
opsbot: Deploy PR #4321 created; canary scheduled 2026-03-18 08:00 UTC.
carmen_cs: I'll draft the customer note once numbers confirmed: brief apology, short RCA, remediation plan, proposed credit (if any), and the invite to enablement. Will post draft here for review before sending.
liam_eng: Hold external comms until I confirm numbers. If impacted % >0.5% we apply the 5% latency credit; otherwise offer the enablement + goodwill credit per sales suggestion.
carmen_cs: Agreed. Target to send combined note tomorrow 16:00 UTC after final numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
